# aggregate rating charts (AllSides, Ad Fontes Media, Media Bias/Fact Check). International outlets are
# 'Unrated' on purpose: the US left/right scale does not transfer to other political systems. Unrated outlets
# count as coverage but are excluded from the L/C/R distribution and the blindspot rules.
# Feed URLs for outlets added in the international expansion were not verified at commit time; the
# Sources page reports live feed health. An empty feedUrl keeps the outlet rated but skips fetching.
# feedUrl may list fallbacks separated by ' | '; they are tried in order.
